text: 当地时间9月12日下午，国家主席习近平在新德里出席金砖国家领导人第十八次会晤第一阶段会议并发表重要讲话。 习近平指出，中东海湾局势仍在复杂演变。这场战事给地区各国人民造成严重损失，也不符合国际社会共同利益。我提出维护和促进中东和平稳定的4点主张，旨在呼吁缓局降温、止战促和。有关各方要坚持政治解决方向，推动实现永久全面停火。中方愿同金砖成员一道，为实现中东海湾地区和平安宁发挥应有作用。（新华社）
text_en: On the afternoon of September 12 local time, President Xi Jinping attended the first phase of the 18th BRICS Leaders' Meeting in New Delhi and delivered an important speech. Xi Jinping pointed out that the situation in the Middle East and the Gulf is still evolving in a complex manner. This war has caused serious losses to the people of the countries in the region and does not conform to the common interests of the international community. I put forward four propositions for safeguarding and promoting peace and stability in the Middle East, aimed at calling for de-escalation and cooling down, ending the war, and promoting peace. Relevant parties should adhere to the direction of political settlement and push for the realization of a permanent and comprehensive ceasefire. China is willing to work with BRICS members to play its due role in realizing peace and tranquility in the Middle East and Gulf region. (Xinhua News Agency)
